verdict.rationale: Runloop Devboxes are full-featured Linux sandboxes. Developers can execute commands at scale, stream or retrieve execution logs, use stateful named shells, and open PTYs for REPLs. Custom Dockerfile blueprints and prebuilt blueprints make arbitrary language runtimes plausible. However, the evidence shows only command-level execution returning logs and output, with no explicit Python or JavaScript runtime support and no rich result types. missing for 10: explicitly documented multi-language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, etc.), rich result outputs (structured data, charts, images, Jupyter-style results), independent or hands-on corroboration.
